name: built-in command once
expected: If you allow this command, it runs once outside Codex’s sandbox, with your account’s access to all your files and to the network, in the working folder shown.

name: custom command session
expected: If you allow this command, it runs once with more access than Codex’s sandbox gives, which may be all of your account’s access to your files and the network, in the working folder shown.
This answer also covers this same command, in this folder, until Codex stops. Nothing is saved.

name: unreported command profile
expected: If you allow this command, it runs once with more access than Codex’s sandbox gives, which may be all of your account’s access to your files and the network, in the working folder shown.

name: no-decline command
expected: Don't allow, and interrupt the turn
Codex offers no way to refuse and let the agent continue: refusing interrupts the turn, and you can then tell the agent what to do instead.

name: file session with project
expected: If you allow this, Codex writes these files where they are shown, including any outside your project folder.
This answer also covers later changes to only these same files, until Codex stops. Nothing is saved.
Locations are read from the paths Codex gave; the App has not followed links.

name: file with unknown project
expected: The App has not established where your project folder is, so it cannot mark which of these are inside it.

name: network deny rule
expected: Apply the proposed network rule for this host
This also applies the network rule Codex proposed for the host shown: it denies network access to that host, and the rule is kept by Codex after this answer.
